name: Worgen in the Woods
label: Quest

clips.title: The story
paras: This errand delivers Calor's letter of recommendation to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire, concluding your pursuit of the savage worgen haunting Duskwood. Impressed by your prowess against the beastly invaders, Calor points you directly to a man fighting deeper threats among the shadows.

Having culled the Nightbane pack stalking Roland's Doom and the shadowed glades, you earn the hard-won respect of Calor. Stationed on the darkened frontiers of the woods, Calor is rarely eager to hand out compliments, let alone formal introductions. Handing over a faded scrap of parchment, he directs you to deliver his word directly to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire, remarking that if they had more fighters of your caliber, their small cohort might finally eclipse the town's beleaguered Night Watch.

Jonathan Carevin operates within Darkshire under tremendous strain, wary of outsiders and perpetually pressed for time. The town faces onslaughts not only from slavering worgen, but also from unresting undead, shadowy demonic forces, and traitorous cultists aiding the corruption from within. Receiving Calor's glowing endorsement breaks Carevin's cold demeanor, confirming you as a trustworthy blade dedicated to preserving the Light against the suffocating terrors of Duskwood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you go, friend. Bring this message to Master Carevin.
He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.
A few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excuse me for my cold reception, friend, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat—and that he has given his recommendation.

There are unsavory types afoot, friend, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
